findings.claim: The reviewed diff is incomplete: it mounts new case queue, detail, and intake modules that are absent from the packet, so the patch cannot build or demonstrate acceptance criteria 1.3 and 1.4.
findings.evidence: The diff adds imports of '@/features/case-queue/components/case-queue' and '@/features/case-queue/components/case-intake', and app-routes.tsx adds lazy import './case-detail-route', but the packet contains no diff entries for any web/src/features/case-queue file or web/src/app/routes/case-detail-route.tsx. It likewise contains no selector, scoped Zustand store, or case-management test diff despite criteria 1.3 and 1.4 being marked complete.
findings.suggested_fix: Add every new case queue/detail/intake component, selector, scoped store, route, and focused test to the tracked change, then regenerate the review packet from a diff that includes untracked files.
